focus: render_template_message with edge case templates — nil body + non-nil subject, empty everything, template with only subject

findings.title: render_template_message crashes with NoMethodError when body is nil
findings.description: Line 775 of job_application.rb calls `channel_message_template.body.gsub(...)` without safe navigation. If body is nil, this raises NoMethodError: undefined method 'gsub' for nil:NilClass. The subject path (line 784) correctly uses `|| ''` to guard against nil. The body path does not.
findings.evidence: Test 5 confirmed: creating a template with body=nil and subject='Test Subject {{JobTitle}}' causes NoMethodError on line 775. In practice, body is always empty string (not nil) because the UI always sends a string, but the asymmetry with the nil-guarded subject path is notable.
findings.reproduction: Create a ChannelMessageTemplate with body: nil (via save!(validate: false)) and call render_template_message — crashes immediately.

tests_passed.result: PASS — subject_raw correctly resolved to 'Software Engineer', empty body returned empty strings for message_raw and message_html
PASS — nil subject correctly fell back to empty string via || '' on line 784, body rendered correctly with placeholder resolved

tests_passed.description: Template with 274-char subject using all 7 placeholders (some twice)
tests_passed.result: PASS — all placeholders resolved, no unresolved {{}} remaining, JobTitle correctly appeared twice, subject_raw length was 213 chars after resolution

tests_passed.description: Template with HTML tags in subject including <b>, <script>, and &
tests_passed.result: PASS — HTML tags passed through Mustache unmodified (expected behavior since subject skips Redcarpet). subject_raw contains raw HTML but is consumed safely: React's JSX text interpolation ({mailMerge.subjectRaw}) auto-escapes HTML. subject_html is not consumed by any frontend component currently.

tests_passed.description: Template with body=nil and subject='Test Subject {{JobTitle}}'
tests_passed.result: CONFIRMED pre-existing crash — NoMethodError on line 775. Not introduced by subject feature.

summary: All 4 assigned test scenarios passed. The subject handling in render_template_message is correctly implemented: nil subject falls back to empty string, placeholders resolve correctly in long subjects with all variable types, and HTML in subjects passes through safely (React auto-escapes on the frontend). One LOW pre-existing issue found: body lacks the same nil guard that subject has (line 775 vs line 784). No HIGH or MEDIUM findings. 0 bugs introduced by the email subjects feature.
